definition.title: People contacts smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of People contacts (claude/people-contacts-spec.md, MYC-165, migration 0140): review a match, merge two people and see a quote or day follow the survivor, delete + restore, edit a number label, mark a number old, promote a contact, export and check the old number is absent. The API path was smoke-tested with a synthetic 3-card file; this is the human half. Tick as you go; type what you saw in the answer boxes; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

values.label: Someone in People who also came in as a contact (a name you know is in both)
A person who has a quote or a day-log day

intro.verdict_html: Six phases, about 25 minutes, all on the PC. Nothing here touches iCloud; that is the separate guide ticket. No AI calls.
prerequisites: The real contacts import has run (People → Contacts chip shows them; /organisation/people/import shows the batch with rows waiting)
{{dup}} appears both under People and in the import review list
{{quoted}} has at least one quote or one day-log day

phases.title: The review list
phases.lede_html: Cards that matched someone on a number, an email or a close name wait for you. Nothing merged by itself.

steps.title: Open /organisation/people/import and the batch. Each waiting row shows the card and the matched person side by side, and says what it matched on
Find {{dup}}. Press MERGE INTO {{dup}}. The row leaves the list; {{dup}}'s page now shows the card's number(s) under Numbers and the card's name as an alias
Pick another waiting row that is a different person with a similar name: KEEP SEPARATE. It appears under the Contacts chip. Pick one you do not want at all: SKIP

phases.title: Merge two people
phases.lede_html: Merge from the list (Select → two cards → Merge) or from a person page (Merge…). Links follow the survivor.

steps.title: Open {{quoted}}'s page and note the quote (or the day under Days). Press + ADD PERSON and create a throwaway person called "Merge Test" with a made-up number
On "Merge Test"'s page press MERGE…, pick {{quoted}}, choose {{quoted}} as the survivor, keep {{quoted}}'s values, MERGE
You land on {{quoted}}'s page: the quote (or day) is still there, the made-up number is now under Numbers, "Merge Test" is gone from People. Paste the old "Merge Test" URL: it opens {{quoted}}

phases.title: Delete and restore
phases.lede_html: Delete is soft: the bin keeps people 30 days.

steps.title: Create another throwaway person "Bin Test". Press DELETE: the dialog says nothing links to them and offers MERGE INSTEAD…. Press DELETE TO BIN
"Bin Test" is gone from People and from ⌘K. Settings → People & teams → Bin lists them with a "gone on" date. Press RESTORE: back in People
Delete "Bin Test" again and leave it in the bin (the nightly run removes it after 30 days)

phases.title: Numbers
phases.lede_html: Every number has an editable label, a current/old state and an export toggle.

steps.title: On {{quoted}}'s page, click a number's label box, type "Old mobile", press Enter. Reload: the label stuck
Press that number's "current" pill: it reads "old", the number is struck through, and its export box unticks itself
Tick the export box back on, then off again. Add a new number with label "Test" and remove it with ×. Use ↑↓ to reorder two numbers; reload: the order stuck

phases.title: Promote
phases.lede_html: A contact becomes a person with one tap, or the first time anything links to it.

steps.title: People → Contacts chip. Press "promote" on one card: it leaves Contacts and appears under People
Pick another contact. On /organisation/quotes add a quote and choose that contact as Who. Back on People it is now under the People chip (promoted by the link). Delete the test quote

phases.title: Export
phases.lede_html: The .vcf is what the iPhone guide uses. Old numbers stay out unless you re-tick them.

steps.title: People → EXPORT .VCF. A file downloads. Open it in a text editor: {{quoted}}'s card is there with UID and the current numbers, and the "Old mobile" number from 4.2 is absent
Re-tick that number's export box, export again: now it is in the file. Set it back the way you want it
Verdict: anything you expected from a contacts app that is missing?
